title: Cy Twombly: Untitled (2007) Poster

description.main: This poster reproduces Untitled (2007), a painting by Cy Twombly shown in the 2022 exhibition Cy Twombly at Gagosian, Beverly Hills. Cursive lines and drips of red paint cross a yellow ground, a gestural vocabulary that traces back to Twombly's 1960s blackboard paintings, here at a larger scale and in a saturated palette.
description.extended:
This poster reproduces Untitled (2007), a painting by Cy Twombly shown in the 2022 exhibition Cy Twombly at Gagosian, Beverly Hills, a survey spanning paintings, sculptures, and works on paper.

The painting sets cursive lines, sweeping arcs, and drips of red paint against a yellow ground, a gestural language that goes back to the grey and white "blackboard" paintings Twombly made in the 1960s and early 1970s. Here the scale is larger and the palette saturated rather than restrained, part of a return to large-format painting that ran through his final decade.

Twombly (1928–2011) worked across painting, drawing, sculpture, and photography over six decades, dividing his time between Italy and the United States. In his last paintings, Untitled (2007) among them, he revisited the gestures of his earliest abstract work at a scale and color intensity he had not used before.
description.artist_bio: Cy Twombly (1928–2011) was an American painter, sculptor, draughtsman, and photographer born in Lexington, Virginia. He worked between Italy and the United States from the late 1950s onward. His late paintings, made in the last decade of his life, returned to the gestural vocabulary of his 1960s blackboard paintings at a larger scale and in a more saturated palette.
description.exhibition_context: Cy Twombly ran at Gagosian, Beverly Hills, from September 15 to December 17, 2022, surveying paintings, sculptures, and works on paper.

notes: Poster reproduces Untitled (2007, acrylic and pencil on wood panel, in artist's frame, 112 3/4 x 79 x 2 3/8 inches / 286.2 x 200.7 x 6.4 cm per the poster's own caption). Produced 2022 for the exhibition Cy Twombly at Gagosian, Beverly Hills, September 15-December 17, 2022, a survey of paintings, sculptures, and works on paper. The painting is reproduced in its original wood frame.
